briefdescription.para: This method should be implemented by targets that mark instructions with the 'usesCustomInserter' flag.

detaileddescription.para: These instructions are special in various ways, which require special support to insert. The specified MachineInstr is created but not inserted into any basic blocks, and this method is called to expand it into a sequence of instructions, potentially also creating new basic blocks and control flow. As long as the returned basic block is different (i.e., we created a new one), the custom inserter is free to modify the rest of MBB.
